title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Genesis 4: Cain and Abel, Cain's descendants, and the birth of Seth.

questions.text: What work did Abel and Cain do?
questions.explanation: Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

answers.text: Abel tilled the ground; Cain kept sheep
Abel kept sheep; Cain tilled the ground
Abel built cities; Cain kept sheep

questions.text: What did Abel bring as his offering?
questions.explanation: Abel brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat, and Yahweh respected Abel and his offering.

answers.text: Bread and wine from his house
The firstborn of his flock and its fat
Grain and oil from his field

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell Cain was crouching at the door?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said that if Cain did not do well, sin crouches at the door, but he was to rule over it.

questions.text: What did Cain answer when Yahweh asked where Abel was?
questions.explanation: Cain said, "I don't know. Am I my brother's keeper?"

answers.text: "He went to the land of Nod"

questions.text: According to Yahweh, what cried to Him from the ground?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "The voice of your brother's blood cries to me from the ground."

questions.text: What did Yahweh do so that anyone finding Cain would not strike him?
questions.explanation: Yahweh appointed a sign for Cain, so that anyone finding him would not strike him.

answers.text: He built a wall around him
He sent him back to Eden
He appointed a sign for Cain

questions.text: Where did Cain live after he left Yahweh's presence?
questions.explanation: Cain left Yahweh's presence and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

answers.text: The land of Havilah, near the river
The land of Cush, south of Eden
The land of Nod, east of Eden

questions.text: After whom did Cain name the city he built?
questions.explanation: Cain's wife gave birth to Enoch, and Cain named the city he built after his son Enoch.

questions.text: Who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe?
questions.explanation: Jubal, the brother of Jabal, was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe.

questions.text: What did Adam's wife say when she named her son Seth?
questions.explanation: She named him Seth, saying that God had given her another child instead of Abel, for Cain killed him.

answers.text: He would comfort them in their work
He would rule over his brothers
God had given her another child instead of Abel
He would build a great city
